P: Serve the snacks when the family plays charades on game night.
S: Buttered popcorn drizzled with white chocolate and sea salt
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate and a pinch of salt, set and broken into clusters, served in big bowls.

Mixed mushrooms seared hard in brown butter with garlic and thyme, piled onto charred sourdough with whipped ricotta and shaved parmesan. Mix 200g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon and salt and whip until smooth. Melt 40g butter in a large pan until golden and nutty, add 400g torn mixed mushrooms and fry over high heat for 5 minutes until browned. Add 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and cook 1 minute. Grill 4 slices of sourdough until charred. Spread with ricotta, pile on the mushrooms and finish with shaved parmesan.
Olaf's honey roast carrots with feta
Honey and thyme roast baby carrots with whipped feta and yoghurt

Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey and thyme until sticky, served with a whipped feta dip. Toss 500g baby carrots with honey, thyme and oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until sticky. Whip 150g feta with 150g Greek yoghurt until smooth. Serve the carrots warm around the dip. Keep one aside for a snowman's nose.
M: Salmon, white fish and prawns simmered with leeks and potatoes
Salmon, white fish and prawns simmered in a creamy broth with leek, potato and dill, served with rye bread.
the Northuldra camp in the forest

Lamb shoulder rubbed with juniper, garlic and rosemary, slow roasted until it falls apart, with charred root vegetables and lingonberry-style jam. Crush 1 tbsp juniper berries with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary leaves, olive oil and salt and rub over a 2kg lamb shoulder. Put in a roasting tin with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and beetroot for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30 minutes. Pull the lamb apart and serve with cranberry sauce.
W: Crisp meringue with whipped cream, blueberries and a dusting of icing sugar
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, topped with whipped cream and blueberries, dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: Warm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and maple syrup

Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and a little maple syrup, ladled into mugs with a cinnamon stick for stirring. Pour 1.5L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 strips of orange peel and 2 tbsp maple syrup. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each. Serve with carrots on the side for anyone who brought a reindeer.

s.note: Buttered popcorn drizzled with white chocolate and sea salt
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 30g melted butter. Spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate and drizzle all over, then sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Leave to set for 30 minutes and break into clusters for game night.

s.n: Olaf's honey roast carrots with feta
s.note: Honey and thyme roast baby carrots with whipped feta and yoghurt

m.note: Salmon, white fish and prawns simmered with leeks and potatoes
m.how: Soften 2 sliced leeks in butter, add 400g diced potatoes and 1L water and simmer until tender. Add 300g salmon and 300g white fish chunks and 200g green prawns and cook 5 minutes. Stir in cream and dill and serve with rye bread.

w.note: Crisp meringue with whipped cream, blueberries and a dusting of icing sugar
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream and blueberries and dust with icing sugar like frost.
